config.autocrop.title: AutoCrop
config.autocrop.option.harvestMode.toolt: Manual: replant mature crops you break yourself. Automatic: harvest and replant nearby mature crops. Use the main Enable AutoCrop switch to turn everything off.
config.autocrop.option.replantDelayTicks: Delay before attempting to replant a harvested crop. Increase if the server has not processed the break before planting. Lower values attempt replanting sooner; server processing can add delay.
config.autocrop.option.auraCooldownTicks: Ticks between automatic harvest sweeps once the current batch finishes. Lower values attempt harvesting sooner.
config.autocrop.option.riskBatchSize.too: Maximum crops to harvest in one automatic batch. Smaller batches spread the work out. Manual replanting ignores this setting.
config.autocrop.option.autoRefillSeeds.t: Use seeds from your inventory when the hotbar runs out. An empty hotbar slot is preferred. If the hotbar is full, your selected item is moved into your inventory to make room.
config.autocrop.option.rememberMissedRep: Automatic harvesting only. Retry positions AutoCrop harvested when replanting fails or seeds are unavailable. Does not fill other empty plots unless Fill Empty Farm Plots is enabled.
config.autocrop.option.missedReplantRetr: Delay between retry attempts for each remembered spot. Increase to reduce packet spam while moving around large farms.
config.autocrop.automatic.description: These settings apply only to automatic harvesting. Only use automation where the server rules allow it.
config.autocrop.option.fillEmptyFarmland: Optional: plant empty farmland using the first neighboring crop type, and plant nether wart on empty soul sand. Requires Remember Missed Replants and automatic harvesting. Can fill deliberately empty plots or change mixed-crop layouts. Off by default.
autocrop.mode.disabled.label: Off
autocrop.mode.manual.label: Manual replanting
autocrop.mode.harvest_risky.label: Automatic harvest
config.autocrop.setup.description: Choose a harvest mode, save, and start farming.
config.autocrop.option.enabled.tooltip: Turn AutoCrop on or off. Preset tuning is kept while it is off.
config.autocrop.preset.server.descriptio: Slower automatic harvesting: one crop per batch, with longer breaks between actions. Replants crops and retries missed spots. Server rules still apply; no preset guarantees anti-cheat compatibility.
config.autocrop.preset.max.description: Fastest available automatic timing and largest harvest batches. Best for singleplayer or servers that allow automation. Does not fill unrelated empty plots.
config.autocrop.advanced.title: Manual settings
config.autocrop.advanced.description: These values override the preset while Manual tuning is on. Turn Manual tuning off to restore the selected preset. Timing uses game ticks (normally 20 ticks = 1 second).
config.autocrop.option.manualTuning.tool: Open the manual settings menu below and tune individual values yourself. Turn this off to use Max or Server (safe) again.
